transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Monday, November 2. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Fresh Iran strikes after US midterms? Inside Trump-Netanyahu's 'tough' call. Donald Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu held a tough phone call regarding Iran and military strategies. They discussed the possibility of military action after the upcoming US midterm elections. Trump expressed readiness for diplomacy, while Netanyahu urged immediate strikes against Iran. Diplomatic initiatives continue, with the US Vice President sending a letter to Iran's national security chief. Gautam Gambhir flags India's biggest challenge ahead of NZ ODIs. Gautam Gambhir, the head coach of India, voiced his worries regarding the untested bowling lineup for the imminent ODI series against New Zealand. With seasoned players like Jasprit Bumrah and Hardik Pandya missing, the team will depend on bowlers such as Mohammed Siraj and Arshdeep Singh. Gambhir emphasises that if the team's performance shines, the bowlers deserve significant recognition. US daylight saving time 2026 ends; clocks fall back 1 hour, sleep experts object. Daylight saving time concluded on November 1, resulting in darker evenings and an extra hour of sleep. The debate continues over making daylight saving time a permanent fixture instead of switching twice yearly. Recent legislation has stalled in the Senate despite bipartisan support from the House. Public opinion favors maintaining standard time over permanent daylight saving time due to sleep cycle considerations. Vietnam's Son Doong: world's largest cave holds jungle, found by local in 1990. Venture into the depths of Vietnam's Son Doong Cave, where a hidden world unfolds beneath ancient limestone. Initially stumbled upon by Ho Khanh in 1990, it wasn't until 2009 that this enchanting cavern was fully mapped, revealing colossal rock formations and a flowing river carved by nature over eons. Since 2013, tours have allowed adventurers to glimpse this delicate ecosystem while promoting sustainable tourism efforts. 400 and counting: Why India are ahead of the curve in six-hitting. India have smashed 400 sixes in 40 T20Is in 2026, becoming the first team to reach the landmark in a calendar year. From Abhishek Sharma's six-hitting at the top to a fearless approach across the batting order, India are redefining T20 batting. Power-hitting coach Julian Wood explains why India are ahead of the curve. 'Mayday mayday': Videos show moment Florida jet crashed near busy road. Videos recorded by motorists captured the moment a business jet carrying nine people plunged from the sky and exploded into a fireball near a busy roadway in Florida on Sunday. Mahadev betting app promoter extradited from Oman, to face CBI court today. Sourabh Chandrakar has been extradited from Oman after being wanted for operating an illegal betting network. The CBI and ED conducted extensive investigations into the Mahadev Online Book cases. Investigators allege that betting operations were run from abroad, routing proceeds through multiple bank accounts. Chandrakar is accused of paying bribes to public servants to facilitate the network's operation. £5 Lewis chess piece found in drawer sells for £735,000 after decades. An extraordinary Lewis chessman carving has fetched an impressive £735,000 at auction. Hidden away in a drawer for more than 55 years by the family of the dealer, this remarkable figure was revealed as a warder, part of the legendary Lewis Chessmen collection. Originally found in 1831, this collection comprises 93 intricately carved pieces from 1150 to 1200 AD, though the auction leaves four original pieces still unaccounted for. SC upholds HC order allowing I-T to reassess income of ex-CJI's sons. Holding that the income tax department is not precluded from conducting reassessment upon discovering evidence suggesting income had escaped assessment, Supreme Court upheld a Delhi high court order allowing the agency to reassess the income of the sons of former Chief Justice of India YK Sabharwal for 2008-09 and 2009-10. Chad Lowe and wife list $3.2m Mar Vista home weeks after daughter's death. Actor Chad Lowe and wife Kim Painter have reportedly listed their 3,239-square-foot Mar Vista home for $3.249 million, weeks after the death of their 13-year-old daughter, Fiona. The couple purchased the four-bedroom property for $3.15 million in March 2025. According to TMZ, they have already accepted an offer, subject to certain conditions. US senators write to Google CEO Sundar Pichai with 9 questions on classroom AI push. Two US senators have requested answers from Google CEO Sundar Pichai about the effects of AI tools on children. They highlighted concerns regarding the integration of AI products in schools and their potential negative impacts. The senators have set a deadline for a response by November 2, 2026. They specifically seek information on research conducted about AI's impact on children's mental health.

The theft of billions of dollars from Binance within a matter of minutes, the biggest crypto heist in history, was orchestrated by North Korean hackers, the FBI has said.
